[Benzinga news, 2026-10-21T13:31:59Z, by staff] Analog Devices Issues Statement Regarding Tutanota Mini-Tender Offer
Analog Devices, Inc. has requested that its shareholders be provided with a copy of its official response regarding a mini-tender offer initiated by Tutanota for shares of ADI common stock.
Analog Devices, Inc. (ADI) has issued a formal communication regarding a mini-tender offer for its common stock initiated by Tutanota. The company has requested that this response be included with all materials distributed to shareholders concerning the offer. This action is a standard governance procedure to ensure shareholders are informed of the company's position on the unsolicited tender offer.
